correctness.rationale: Independent exact algebra confirms the limiting optimization block polynomial and the Schur/Jury inequalities. At s=19800/859, P_s(-1)=0 exactly; the corresponding inequality is positive below and negative immediately above, while the other upper bound is looser and the remaining conditions are positive for s>0. The first-moment-only comparison gives 198 and ratio 859/100. The frozen RESULT.md, however, contains two literal form-feed control bytes corrupting two \frac commands and prints 19800/859 as 23.049; the true value is 23.0500582072.... The repaired final RESULT.md fixes only those transcription defects and leaves the theorem/proof unchanged.
